$comment: Hotspots for the train map. Coordinates are metres in the normalized train frame: rail top at y=0, car centred on x=0 and z=0, nose pointing to +x, +z is the side the default camera looks at. The GLB is fitted into this frame by model.transform (rotation, then scale, then auto-centre), and the procedural placeholder is built in the same frame, so one set of positions serves both. position = hotspot anchor. meshNames = object names in the GLB whose triangles belong to the part (match on the object or any ancestor). glb.carve = boxes {min,max} that claim triangles and edges of any mesh for the part (beats meshNames). glb.outline = boxes drawn as part-coloured outlines where the GLB has no geometry (optional repeat {count, step}); the placeholder renders them as solid boxes. profile = weight profile id from list_profiles. description = one or two sentences shown in the part panel.

parts.label: Brake system
parts.description: Disc brakes, brake control units and the pneumatic supply on both bogies. Safety relevant: any change needs a new safety case.

parts.label: Bogie frames and wheelsets
parts.description: Welded bogie frames with wheelsets, axle bearings and primary suspension. Long-lead forgings with few qualified suppliers.

parts.label: Car body shell
parts.description: Welded aluminium extrusions forming the load-carrying shell, including the crash structure of the end car.

parts.label: Traction motors and gearboxes
parts.description: Asynchronous traction motors with their gearboxes, mounted on the powered bogies.

parts.label: Traction converter and transformer
parts.description: Underfloor main transformer and traction converter that feed the motors from the overhead line.

parts.label: Pantograph
parts.description: Roof current collector with its insulators and roof line. Collects power from the overhead contact wire.

parts.label: Couplers and gangways
parts.description: Automatic couplers, draft gear and the gangway between the end car and the intermediate car.

parts.label: Passenger doors
parts.description: Electrically driven plug sliding doors with steps and obstacle detection. Part of the passenger safety chain.

parts.label: HVAC roof units
parts.description: Roof-mounted heating, ventilation and air-conditioning units for the passenger saloon.

parts.label: Train control and TCMS
parts.description: Train control and monitoring system (TCMS), the ETCS onboard unit and the train bus.

parts.label: Driver's cab and HMI
parts.description: Driver's desk, displays and controls, plus the cab structure behind the nose.

parts.label: Battery and auxiliary power
parts.description: Auxiliary converter and battery boxes that supply on-board systems and emergency loads.

parts.label: Interiors, seats, lighting
parts.description: Seats, luggage racks, wall and ceiling panels and saloon lighting. Supply chain checked under LkSG.
